entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • CA2000 Does not warn on IDisposable instances returned by interface method. #81700
  • [Broken Build]: Nullability issue with extension blocks #81699
  • Assertion failed, `awaiterFieldRef.Type.IsObjectType()` building Razor.sln #81695

Closed

  • `CSharpMergeNestedIfStatementsCodeRefactoringProvider` encountered an error and has been disabled #74772
    18.3
  • C# completion list omits parameters in primary constructor when the parameter is used as an argument to the base class #81008
  • NotNullIfNotNull does not ensure not nullability on properties #81697
  • Warning for readonly ref struct inner field #81690

PullRequests

Created

  • Update BCL packages from 9.0 to 10.0 #81702
  • Unsafe evolution: implement compat mode #81701
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Unsafe evolution: check lang version for caller-unsafe declarations #81698
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution

Merged

  • Add specific error for extension parameter usage in static members #81606
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Copy slightly less data during SourceText.computeContentHash #81682
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Unsafe evolution: check caller unsafe context for usages of some methods and properties #81581
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution

Updated

  • Use ArrayExpansion for fixed buffer fields #81536
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Extensions: FindReferences should link extension members and implementations #81685
    Area-IDE, Feature - Extension Everything, VSCode
  • Implement compiler support for System.Runtime.InteropServices.ExtendedLayoutAttribute #78741
    Area-Compilers
  • Don't report assignment to ref extension parameter as unused #81680
    Area-IDE, Feature - Extension Everything, VSCode
  • HotReloadMSBuildWorkspace #81577
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • DeclarationTable allocation reductions #81627
    Area-Compilers
